// The pen engine: framework-free, so it runs at build time, in share-image rendering and in the browser. Importing it
// registers every object in the library.
export { seedOf, prng, fork, stream, type Stream } from "./seed"
export {
  WOBBLE_VARIANTS,
  wobbleFilter,
  sharedFilters,
  frameVars,
} from "./filters"
export * from "./geometry"
export { pen, HANDS, type Pen, type HandName } from "./stroke"
export { plot, type Plot } from "./plot"
export { sheet, type Sheet } from "./layers"
export { box, cylinder, depth, handle, scribble, type Box } from "./shapes"
export {
  COLLECTIONS,
  define,
  objectsIn,
  getObject,
  listObjects,
  place,
  tile,
  type Collection,
  type Draw,
  type DrawOptions,
  type DrawingObject,
} from "./library"
export { SCENES, type Scene, type SceneName } from "./scenes"
export { drawing, type DrawingOptions } from "./drawing-svg"
export { GLYPHS, type Glyph } from "./glyphs"
export {
  FACES,
  lettering,
  type FaceName,
  type LetteringOptions,
} from "./lettering-svg"
export { MARKS, penMark, penBorder, type MarkName } from "./pen-marks"
import "./objects"

// Food & drink: a bistro's table for two, from the wine to the lamp above it. `at` is bottom-centre unless a
// function says otherwise. Composition comes from `r` (the shape stream), never from the pen, so takes agree.
import { add, arc, dot, type Point } from "../geometry"
import { define, type Draw, objectsIn } from "../library"
import { scribble } from "../shapes"

export const bottle: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const half = 10 + r.next() * 2
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + u * k, y - v * k]
  const outline = [
    P(-half, 0),
    P(-half, 66),
    P(-half + 2, 76),
    P(-3.6, 86),
    P(-3.6, 112),
    P(3.6, 112),
    P(3.6, 86),
    P(half - 2, 76),
    P(half, 66),
    P(half, 0),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(outline))
  s.stroke(p.path([...outline, outline[0] as Point]))
  s.fill(p.shape([P(-4, 98), P(4, 98), P(4, 112), P(-4, 112)]))
  s.stroke(
    p.edges([
      P(-half + 2.5, 18),
      P(half - 2.5, 18),
      P(half - 2.5, 48),
      P(-half + 2.5, 48),
    ]),
  )
  s.stroke(p.ring(...dot(P(0, 33), 4 * k)))
}

/** A wine glass, poured unless `wine` is false. */
export const glass: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1, { wine = true } = {}) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + u * k, y - v * k]
  s.stroke(p.ring(P(0, 1.5), [11 * k, 0], [0, 2.5 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line(P(0, 2), P(0, 26)))
  const bowl = arc([0, 44], 14, 20, 180, 360, 14).map(([u, v]) => P(u, v))
  const rim = [P(-11, 56), ...bowl, P(11, 56)]
  s.blank(p.shape(rim))
  if (wine) s.fill(p.shape([...bowl.slice(3, 12), P(12, 37), P(-12, 37)]))
  s.stroke(p.path(rim))
  s.stroke(p.ring(P(0, 56), [11 * k, 0], [0, 2.6 * k]))
}

export const carafe: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + u * k, y - v * k]
  const body = [
    P(-6, 92),
    P(-6, 70),
    ...arc([0, 36], 24, 34, 250, -70, 18).map(([u, v]) => P(u, 72 - v)),
    P(6, 70),
    P(6, 92),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(body))
  s.wash(
    p.shape(arc([0, 36], 23, 33, 20, 160, 12).map(([u, v]) => P(u, 72 - v))),
  )
  s.stroke(p.path(body))
  s.stroke(p.ring(P(0, 92), [6 * k, 0], [0, 1.8 * k]))
}

/** A candle stuck in a bottle, with two drips of wax. */
export const candle: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + u * k, y - v * k]
  const body = [
    P(-15, 0),
    P(-15, 38),
    P(-6, 50),
    P(-6, 62),
    P(6, 62),
    P(6, 50),
    P(15, 38),
    P(15, 0),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(body))
  s.stroke(p.path([...body, body[0] as Point]))
  s.stroke(p.edges([P(-5, 62), P(5, 62), P(5, 92), P(-5, 92)]))
  const drips: Point[] = [
    [-5, 80],
    [5, 74],
  ]
  for (const [u, v] of drips)
    s.stroke(p.path([P(u, v + 10), P(u + Math.sign(u) * 1.5, v + 4), P(u, v)]))
  s.stroke(p.line(P(0, 92), P(0, 96)))
  s.fill(p.shape([P(0, 97), P(3.4, 103), P(0, 112), P(-3.4, 103)]))
}

export const cutlery: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const fork = (c: Point) => {
    s.stroke(
      p.edges(
        [
          add(c, [-2 * k, 0]),
          add(c, [2 * k, 0]),
          add(c, [2.5 * k, -62 * k]),
          add(c, [-2.5 * k, -62 * k]),
        ],
        false,
      ),
    )
    s.stroke(
      p.path([
        add(c, [-2.5 * k, -62 * k]),
        add(c, [-8 * k, -70 * k]),
        add(c, [-8 * k, -92 * k]),
      ]),
    )
    s.stroke(
      p.path([
        add(c, [2.5 * k, -62 * k]),
        add(c, [8 * k, -70 * k]),
        add(c, [8 * k, -92 * k]),
      ]),
    )
    for (const dx of [-2.6, 2.6])
      s.stroke(p.line(add(c, [dx * k, -72 * k]), add(c, [dx * k, -92 * k])))
  }
  const knife = (c: Point) =>
    s.stroke(
      p.path([
        add(c, [-3 * k, 0]),
        add(c, [-3 * k, -54 * k]),
        add(c, [-4 * k, -94 * k]),
        add(c, [4 * k, -78 * k]),
        add(c, [3 * k, -54 * k]),
        add(c, [3 * k, 0]),
        add(c, [-3 * k, 0]),
      ]),
    )
  fork([x - 14 * k, y])
  knife([x + 14 * k, y])
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 11 * k, y - 54 * k], [x + 17 * k, y - 54 * k]))
}

/** A folded menu card standing on the table, its dishes scribbled. */
export const menuCard: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const face: Point[] = [
    [x - 34 * k, y],
    [x + 34 * k, y],
    [x + 28 * k, y - 96 * k],
    [x - 28 * k, y - 96 * k],
  ]
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 34 * k, y], [x + 46 * k, y - 10 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 28 * k, y - 96 * k], [x + 40 * k, y - 104 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 46 * k, y - 10 * k], [x + 40 * k, y - 104 * k]))
  s.blank(p.shape(face))
  s.stroke(p.edges(face))
  s.stroke(p.ring([x, y - 80 * k], [10 * k, 0], [0, 5 * k]))
  scribble(s, p, r, x - 20 * k, y - 62 * k, 40 * k, 6, 8 * k)
}

/** A round table on one leg: `at` is the centre of its foot, and its top is 104 × k above it. */
export const bistroTable: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const top: Point = [x, y - 104 * k]
  s.stroke(p.line([x - 2 * k, top[1] + 8 * k], [x - 2 * k, y - 6 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 2 * k, top[1] + 8 * k], [x + 2 * k, y - 6 * k]))
  s.stroke(
    p.path([
      [x - 30 * k, y],
      [x - 4 * k, y - 8 * k],
      [x + 4 * k, y - 8 * k],
      [x + 30 * k, y],
    ]),
  )
  s.blank(
    p.shape([
      ...arc(top, 70 * k, 18 * k, 180, 360, 14),
      ...arc(add(top, [0, 6 * k]), 70 * k, 18 * k, 0, 180, 14),
    ]),
  )
  s.stroke(p.ring(top, [70 * k, 0], [0, 18 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.path(arc(add(top, [0, 6 * k]), 70 * k, 18 * k, 0, 180, 14)))
  s.stroke(p.line([x - 70 * k, top[1]], [x - 70 * k, top[1] + 6 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 70 * k, top[1]], [x + 70 * k, top[1] + 6 * k]))
}

/** A pendant lamp hanging from `top` (default 60 above the shade); `at` is the bottom-centre of the shade. */
export const pendant: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1, { top } = {}) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  s.stroke(p.line([x, top ?? y - 90 * k], [x, y - 30 * k]))
  s.fill(
    p.shape([
      [x - 5 * k, y - 30 * k],
      [x + 5 * k, y - 30 * k],
      [x + 26 * k, y],
      [x - 26 * k, y],
    ]),
  )
  s.stroke(p.path(arc([x, y], 8 * k, 7 * k, 0, 180, 8)))
}

const T = objectsIn("food")

define(
  T("bottle", "Wine bottle", [60, 140], [30, 132], 1.05, bottle, [
    "drink",
    "wine",
    "restaurant",

  T("glass", "Wine glass", [60, 80], [30, 74], 1.15, glass, [
    "drink",
    "wine",
    "toast",
  ]),
  T("carafe", "Carafe", [70, 120], [35, 112], 1, carafe, [
    "drink",
    "water",
    "restaurant",
  ]),
  T("candle", "Candle", [50, 130], [25, 122], 1, candle, [
    "light",
    "evening",
    "restaurant",
  ]),
  T("cutlery", "Fork and knife", [70, 110], [35, 102], 1, cutlery, [
    "meal",
    "restaurant",
  ]),
  T("menu", "Menu card", [100, 120], [44, 112], 1, menuCard, [
    "restaurant",
    "menu",
    "prices",
  ]),
  T("bistro-table", "Bistro table", [160, 130], [80, 124], 1, bistroTable, [
    "furniture",
    "restaurant",
    "cafe",
  ]),
  T("pendant", "Pendant lamp", [80, 120], [40, 108], 1, pendant, [
    "light",
    "lamp",

// Studio: the freelancer's desk and what collects on it. Each function draws one object; `at` is its anchor and `k`
// its scale. Composition comes from `r` (the shape stream), never from the pen, so takes agree.
import { add, arc, dot, lerp, rect, turn, type Point } from "../geometry"
import { define, type Draw, objectsIn } from "../library"
import { box, cylinder, depth, handle, scribble } from "../shapes"

type Quad = [Point, Point, Point, Point]

/** A desk whose front-left foot stands at `at`. Returns its top, for placing things on it. */
export const desk: Draw = (
  s,
  p,
  r,
  at,
  k = 1,
  { w = 230 * k, d = 70 * k, legs = 70 * k } = {},
) => {
  const o = depth(r)
  const [x, y] = at
  const back = (u: number) => add([x + w * u, y - legs], o, d)
  s.stroke(p.line(add(back(0), [3 * k, 0]), add(back(0), [3 * k, legs])))
  s.stroke(p.line(add(back(1), [-3 * k, 0]), add(back(1), [-3 * k, legs])))
  const under: Point = [x + w * 0.66, y - legs + 26 * k]
  const drawer = box(s, p, o, under, w * 0.3, 20 * k, d * 0.9)
  s.stroke(p.line(drawer.front(0.4, 0.5), drawer.front(0.6, 0.5)))
  const top = box(s, p, o, [x, y - legs], w, 7 * k, d)
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 3 * k, y - legs], [x + 3 * k, y]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + w - 3 * k, y - legs], [x + w - 3 * k, y]))
  return top
}

export const officeChair: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const hub: Point = [x, y - 12 * k]
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const a = 200 + i * 36
    const end = add(hub, [
      Math.cos((a * Math.PI) / 180) * 34 * k,
      Math.abs(Math.sin((a * Math.PI) / 180)) * 9 * k + 2 * k,
    ])
    s.stroke(p.line(hub, end))
    s.stroke(p.ring(add(end, [0, 3 * k]), [3 * k, 0], [0, 3 * k]))
  }
  s.stroke(p.line([x - 2.5 * k, y - 12 * k], [x - 2.5 * k, y - 50 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.line([x + 2.5 * k, y - 12 * k], [x + 2.5 * k, y - 50 * k]))
  const back: Point[] = [
    [x - 22 * k, y - 66 * k],
    [x + 22 * k, y - 66 * k],
    [x + 24 * k, y - 120 * k],
    [x - 24 * k, y - 120 * k],
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(back))
  s.stroke(p.edges(back))
  s.stroke(p.line([x, y - 66 * k], [x, y - 58 * k]))
  const seat: Point = [x, y - 58 * k]
  s.blank(
    p.shape([
      ...arc(seat, 30 * k, 9 * k, 180, 360, 10),
      ...arc(add(seat, [0, 6 * k]), 30 * k, 9 * k, 0, 180, 10),
    ]),
  )
  s.stroke(p.ring(seat, [30 * k, 0], [0, 9 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.path(arc(add(seat, [0, 6 * k]), 30 * k, 9 * k, 0, 180, 12)))
}

/** An anglepoise lamp, facing left or right from the seed. */
export const deskLamp: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const flip = r.chance(0.5) ? 1 : -1
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + flip * u * k, y - v * k]
  s.blank(p.disc(P(0, 4), [24 * k, 0], [0, 6 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.ring(P(0, 4), [24 * k, 0], [0, 6 * k]))
  const [joint, head] = [P(-18, 70), P(34, 104)]
  s.stroke(p.line(P(0, 6), joint))
  s.stroke(p.line(joint, head))
  s.stroke(p.ring(...dot(joint, 3.5 * k)))
  const shade = [head, P(28, 112), P(62, 86), P(50, 74)].map((pt) =>
    turn(pt, head, flip * 6),
  ) as Quad
  s.fill(p.shape(shade))
  const bulb = lerp(shade[2], shade[3], 0.5)
  s.stroke(
    p.path(
      arc(bulb, 7 * k, 5 * k, 0, 180, 8).map((pt) =>
        turn(pt, bulb, flip * -40),
      ),
    ),
  )
}

/** A stack of three books, sometimes with a bookmark. */
export const books: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const o = depth(r)
  let [x, y] = at
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const w = r.between(70, 96) * k
    const h = r.between(9, 14) * k
    const b = box(s, p, o, [x, y], w, h, 50 * k)
    s.stroke(p.line(b.front(0.06, 0.15), b.front(0.06, 0.85)))
    if (r.chance(0.5)) s.stroke(p.line(b.front(0.8, 0.5), b.front(0.94, 0.5)))
    x += r.signed() * 8 * k
    y -= h
  }
  if (r.chance(0.6))
    s.fill(
      p.shape([
        [x + 30 * k, y],
        [x + 36 * k, y],
        [x + 36 * k, y + 22 * k],
        [x + 33 * k, y + 18 * k],
        [x + 30 * k, y + 22 * k],
      ]),
    )
}

/** An open sketchbook, `at` its bottom-left: notes on the left page, a house and a pencil on the right. */
export const sketchbook: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const o: Point = [0.28 + r.signed() * 0.06, -0.62]
  const [x, y] = at
  const [w, d] = [74 * k, 78 * k]
  const page = (x0: number): Quad => [
    [x0, y],
    [x0 + w, y],
    add([x0 + w, y], o, d),
    add([x0, y], o, d),
  ]
  const [left, right] = [page(x), page(x + w)]
  s.blank(p.shape([left[0], right[1], right[2], left[3]]))
  s.stroke(p.edges(left))
  s.stroke(p.edges(right))
  const q = (pg: Quad, u: number, v: number) =>
    lerp(lerp(pg[0], pg[1], u), lerp(pg[3], pg[2], u), v)
  for (let v = 0.25; v < 0.85; v += 0.15)
    s.stroke(p.line(q(left, 0.15, v), q(left, r.between(0.6, 0.85), v)))
  const house = [
    q(right, 0.3, 0.3),
    q(right, 0.62, 0.3),
    q(right, 0.62, 0.55),
    q(right, 0.46, 0.72),
    q(right, 0.3, 0.55),
  ]
  s.stroke(p.edges(house))
  s.fill(
    p.shape([
      q(right, 0.42, 0.3),
      q(right, 0.5, 0.3),
      q(right, 0.5, 0.42),
      q(right, 0.42, 0.42),
    ]),
  )
  const [tip, end] = [q(right, 0.55, 0.15), q(right, 1.15, 0.95)]
  const side: Point = [0, 3 * k]
  const pencil: Quad = [
    lerp(tip, end, 0.08),
    end,
    add(end, side),
    add(lerp(tip, end, 0.08), side),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape([tip, ...pencil]))
  s.stroke(p.edges(pencil))
  s.fill(p.shape([tip, pencil[0], pencil[3]]))
  s.stroke(
    p.line(lerp(pencil[0], pencil[1], 0.86), lerp(pencil[3], pencil[2], 0.86)),
  )
}

/** Three sticky notes on the wall, each a little askew, with a pin and a few lines. */
export const stickyNotes: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const c: Point = [
      x + (i * 46 + r.signed() * 4) * k,
      y - (26 + (i % 2) * 14) * k,
    ]
    const tilt = r.signed() * 7
    const note = rect(c[0] - 20 * k, c[1] - 20 * k, 40 * k, 40 * k).map((pt) =>
      turn(pt, c, tilt),
    )
    s.blank(p.shape(note))
    s.wash(p.shape(note))
    s.stroke(p.edges(note))
    s.fill(p.disc(...dot(turn([c[0], c[1] - 15 * k], c, tilt), 2 * k)))
    scribble(s, p, r, c[0] - 13 * k, c[1] - 4 * k, 26 * k, 3, 7 * k)
  }
}

/** A full mug with a heart or a scribble on it. People hold one too. */
export const mug: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const cup = cylinder(s, p, [x, y - 44 * k], 20 * k, 6 * k, 40 * k)
  handle(s, p, x + 20 * k, y - 36 * k, y - 14 * k, 11 * k)
  s.fill(p.disc(cup.top, [16.5 * k, 0], [0, 4.4 * k]))
  const m: Point = [x - 2 * k, y - 22 * k]
  if (r.chance(0.5))
    s.fill(
      p.shape([
        add(m, [0, 6 * k]),
        add(m, [-7 * k, -1 * k]),
        add(m, [-4 * k, -6 * k]),
        add(m, [0, -3 * k]),
        add(m, [4 * k, -6 * k]),
        add(m, [7 * k, -1 * k]),
      ]),
    )
  else scribble(s, p, r, x - 12 * k, y - 26 * k, 22 * k, 2, 6 * k)
}

export const coffeeToGo: Draw = (s, p, _r, at, k = 1) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const cup: Point[] = [
    [x - 13 * k, y],
    [x + 13 * k, y],
    [x + 19 * k, y - 66 * k],
    [x - 19 * k, y - 66 * k],
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(cup))
  s.stroke(p.edges(cup))
  const sleeve: Point[] = [
    [x - 15 * k, y - 18 * k],
    [x + 15 * k, y - 18 * k],
    [x + 17.5 * k, y - 46 * k],
    [x - 17.5 * k, y - 46 * k],
  ]
  s.wash(p.shape(sleeve))
  s.stroke(p.edges(sleeve))
  s.stroke(p.ring([x, y - 32 * k], [6 * k, 0], [0, 6 * k]))
  s.stroke(p.edges(rect(x - 21 * k, y - 74 * k, 42 * k, 8 * k)))
  s.stroke(
    p.path([
      [x - 17 * k, y - 74 * k],
      [x - 13 * k, y - 82 * k],
      [x + 13 * k, y - 82 * k],
      [x + 17 * k, y - 74 * k],
    ]),
  )
}

// Every collection registers its objects when imported. Add a collection file here; its objects then appear in
// drawing(), the scenes and the docs.

import "./visitors"

// People: visitors who are only their clothes, and a cat. `at` is where they stand (bottom-centre) and `k` their
// scale. Composition comes from `r` (the shape stream), never from the pen, so takes agree.
import { add, arc, dot, type Point } from "../geometry"
import { define, type Draw, objectsIn } from "../library"
import { clothes } from "./people"

/** A shirt and trousers with nobody in them, standing, walking or carrying a record. */
export const visitor: Draw = (
  s,
  p,
  r,
  at,
  k = 1,
  { pose = r.pick(["stand", "walk", "record"]) } = {},
) => {
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [at[0] + u * k, at[1] + v * k]
  const { hands } = clothes(s, p, r, at, k, {
    pose: pose === "record" ? "mug" : pose,
    stride: pose === "walk" ? 9 : r.signed() * 2,
    nobody: true,
  })
  s.stroke(p.ring(P(0, -162.5), [8 * k, 0], [0, 2.6 * k]))
  if (pose === "record") {
    const h = hands[1] as Point
    const sleeveBox = [
      add(h, [-24 * k, -14 * k]),
      add(h, [4 * k, -14 * k]),
      add(h, [4 * k, 14 * k]),
      add(h, [-24 * k, 14 * k]),
    ]
    s.fill(p.shape(arc(add(h, [-24 * k, 0]), 12 * k, 12 * k, 90, 270, 8)))
    s.blank(p.shape(sleeveBox))
    s.stroke(p.edges(sleeveBox))
    s.stroke(
      p.path([
        add(h, [-18 * k, -6 * k]),
        add(h, [-12 * k, -2 * k]),
        add(h, [-16 * k, 4 * k]),
        add(h, [-6 * k, 6 * k]),
      ]),
    )
  }
}

export const visitorRecord: Draw = (s, p, r, at, k) =>
  visitor(s, p, r, at, k, { pose: "record" })

/** A sitting cat, black or white from the seed, its tail to one side. */
export const cat: Draw = (
  s,
  p,
  r,
  at,
  k = 1,
  { black = r.chance(0.4) } = {},
) => {
  const [x, y] = at
  const P = (u: number, v: number): Point => [x + u * k, y - v * k]
  const tail = r.chance(0.5) ? 1 : -1
  s.stroke(
    p.path([
      P(tail * 18, 4),
      P(tail * 34, 10),
      P(tail * 36, 28),
      P(tail * 28, 40),
    ]),
  )
  const body = [
    P(-12, 44),
    P(-20, 26),
    P(-23, 8),
    P(-19, 0),
    P(19, 0),
    P(23, 8),
    P(20, 26),
    P(12, 44),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(body))
  if (black) s.fill(p.shape(body))
  s.stroke(p.path([...body, body[0] as Point]))
  const c = P(0, 60)
  const face = [
    ...arc(c, 16 * k, 14 * k, -20, 200, 16),
    add(c, [-14 * k, -19 * k]),
    add(c, [-6 * k, -12 * k]),
    add(c, [6 * k, -12 * k]),
    add(c, [14 * k, -19 * k]),
  ]
  s.blank(p.shape(face))
  if (black) s.fill(p.shape(face))
  s.stroke(p.path([...face, face[0] as Point]))
  const eye = black
    ? (pt: Point) => s.paper(p.disc(...dot(pt, 1.6 * k)))
    : (pt: Point) => s.fill(p.disc(...dot(pt, 1.4 * k)))
  eye(add(c, [-6 * k, 0]))
  eye(add(c, [6 * k, 0]))
  if (!black) {
    s.fill(
      p.shape([
        add(c, [-1.6 * k, 4 * k]),
        add(c, [1.6 * k, 4 * k]),
        add(c, [0, 6 * k]),
      ]),
    )
    for (const side of [-1, 1])
      for (const dy of [5, 8])
        s.stroke(
          p.line(
            add(c, [side * 5 * k, dy * k]),
            add(c, [side * 17 * k, (dy + (dy - 6.5) * 1.5) * k]),
          ),
        )
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++)
      s.stroke(p.line(P(-14 + i * 3, 14 + i * 9), P(-6 + i * 3, 16 + i * 9)))
  }
}

const T = objectsIn("people")

define(
  T("visitor", "Visitor", [110, 220], [50, 212], 1.15, visitor, [
    "person",
    "guest",
    "anonymous",
  ]),
  T(
    "visitor-record",
    "Visitor with a record",
    [110, 220],
    [50, 212],
    1.15,
    visitorRecord,
    ["person", "music", "shopping"],
  ),
  T("cat", "Cat", [100, 110], [50, 100], 1.1, cat, ["pet", "animal", "home"]),
)
